Exercises › Triceps

How to do the Chest Dips

An intermediate compound exercise for the triceps and chest.

How to do it

  1. Grip parallel dip bars and lift yourself to the top position with arms locked.
  2. Lean your torso forward slightly.
  3. Lower your body by bending your elbows until shoulders are below elbows.
  4. Press back up to the starting position.
  5. Repeat.

Muscles worked

Primary
Triceps and Chest
Secondary
Front delts
Equipment
Dip bars
Level
Intermediate
